reason: ₱1,800 is a lot when I can get a full set of press-ons from Shopee for a couple hundred and stick them on while the kids nap. Home service is nice, but for a normal week it's not worth that much to me.
objection: Press-ons from Shopee look good enough for much less, and I'd be paying ₱1,800 every few weeks just to keep it up.
would_change_my_mind: If I had a wedding or big event coming up, the venue service with the photo-approved design and the 48-hour chip fix would make me book. Or a simpler plain gel option closer to ₱700-800.
